priorities.requirement: Fix Wii interface/library polling so files that are not actual Wii games are excluded from the native Wii game library.

Add Huymaier Console action/button remapping so users can assign controller buttons to Huymaier actions as they choose while preserving global Guide/Home semantics unless explicitly remapped by an approved design.
Allow apps to be removed from the Apps library and stop broad pre-scanning/pre-importing applications that overload the list with junk. Prefer explicit/manual app import and user-managed entries.

Add a Recomps provider to Games with a retro-inspired presentation while following the Steam/GOG shelf and library model. Support importing a folder or a specific game executable, retain the executable as the launch target, and resolve/download cover art using the game name.

Every active provider download/install must expose an explicit Huymaier phase state and ETA. Show Downloading while transfer activity is occurring, automatically transition to Installing when installation begins, and show an ETA for both phases. Prefer provider/backend-native state, progress, speed, and ETA when supplied. When a backend does not provide them, Huymaier must fall back to observing expected total size versus bytes/files transferred or destination growth, sample and smooth the current transfer/install throughput, and calculate ETA from remaining work divided by measured speed. Apply the fallback independently to both download and install phases so Downloads never sits in a generic or ambiguous active state merely because a provider omits telemetry.
